The routine stops producing new ones either way.
Nothing is deleted and nothing is changed.
There is no in-app undo. Recovery is from version
Due and overdue are computed from the recurrence and
the preferred days of the active routines. A paused
routine is neither, and the days it spends paused never
become overdue. The computation writes nothing.
Every form on this surface drafts as it is filled in, so
leaving it half-finished, a crash and a restart all cost
nothing. The draft is one-way: nothing waits for it to be
kept. Whichever write commits the form discards it.
One request covers both directions. A paused routine
leaves the focus selectables and the due computation,
and returns to both on resume.
